story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 2 — Royal Audience / The Chapter-2 Report
scene_purpose: Transfer the essential Chapter-2 Old Bastion and Ancient-route facts into Crown knowledge through a working royal audience; preserve provenance between firsthand observation and prisoner testimony; place Torren's copied western-mural evidence before Lysara, Mirena, and Calder; establish the enormous Ancient city at modern Caelora and the separate northern structure bearing the exact Yahtrean Crest as unresolved state-level questions; then reconnect the report to the recovered Card and end when Lysara requests the actual transport authorization documents for direct review.

scene_context_seed.runtime_note: This is a practical working audience, not a ceremonial throne-room spectacle. Maevra owns the report. Other participants speak selectively according to expertise and evidence. Use portraits + dialogue box with simple field placement. No elaborate court choreography or ceremonial exposition.

required_story_beats: Maevra reports that the Old Bastion was a Black Host holding/transit site and that the prisoners still there were freed.
Rhazek is identified as the local commander, alive after withdrawing with remaining organized Host forces.
Earlier transferred captives remain missing; prisoner testimony establishes they were moved before the party arrived, but nobody can name their destination or fate.
The Crown learns the party reached the Bastion through Old Waterworks into substantially older Ancient infrastructure and a concealed Ancient passage beneath the Bastion.
Torren presents the copied western mural evidence and distinguishes what he copied from what he can actually conclude.
The Crown recognizes an enormous Ancient city at modern Caelora's location and a separate northern structure marked with the exact modern Crest of Yahtrea.
No participant explains why the exact modern Crest appears on Ancient material or identifies the northern site.
The surviving Old City beneath Caelora is recognized as a plausible future research direction without starting the expedition yet.
The report returns to Cyanis's recovered Card and Maevra states that its movement toward Caelora was understood to be Crown-directed.
Beat ends when Lysara requests the actual physical transport orders/authorization documents for direct review.
